wrap-break-word dark markdown-new-styling"><p data-start="0" data-end="196">Yep — this is exactly the real nuance: <strong data-start="39" data-end="109">“include options” doesn’t mean “include every conceivable option.”</strong> In practice you’re doing <em data-start="135" data-end="150">option triage</em>, and that’s where the hidden influence lives.</p>
<p data-start="198" data-end="316">If there are 8 options and you shortlist 3, you’re still being honest <strong data-start="268" data-end="274">if</strong> your filtering is principled and visible.</p>
<h3 data-start="318" data-end="353">The clean way to think about it</h3>
<p data-start="354" data-end="453">There are 3 different reasons an option gets left out, and only one of them is ethically “squishy”:</p>
<ol data-start="455" data-end="791">
<li data-start="455" data-end="668">
<p data-start="458" data-end="668"><strong data-start="458" data-end="497">Dominated options (easy to exclude)</strong><br>
Option C is strictly worse than another option on every dimension that matters (time, cost, accuracy, risk, maintainability).<br data-start="623" data-end="626">
→ Leaving it out is just good engineering.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="670" data-end="791">
<p data-start="673" data-end="791"><strong data-start="673" data-end="728">Constraint-violating options (also easy to exclude)</strong><br>
It might be “best” technically but violates a hard constraint:</p>
</li>
</ol>
<ul data-start="792" data-end="949">
<li data-start="792" data-end="819">
<p data-start="794" data-end="819">needs data you don’t have</p>
</li>
<li data-start="820" data-end="865">
<p data-start="822" data-end="865">requires workflow change they won’t approve</p>
</li>
<li data-start="866" data-end="886">
<p data-start="868" data-end="886">legal/privacy risk</p>
</li>
<li data-start="887" data-end="949">
<p data-start="889" data-end="949">cannot be delivered in timeline<br>
→ Leaving it out is correct.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<ol start="3" data-start="951" data-end="1262">
<li data-start="951" data-end="1262">
<p data-start="954" data-end="1262"><strong data-start="954" data-end="1010">Preference-based exclusions (this is the subtle one)</strong><br>
You don’t like it because you think it’s fragile, hard to maintain, or creates perverse incentives — but it’s <em data-start="1121" data-end="1126">not</em> obviously dominated and <em data-start="1151" data-end="1160">doesn’t</em> violate a hard constraint.<br data-start="1187" data-end="1190">
→ This is where your influence is real, and where documentation matters.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="1264" data-end="1336">The trick is: <strong data-start="1278" data-end="1336">turn #3 into #1 or #2 by making the criteria explicit.</strong></p>
<hr data-start="1338" data-end="1341">
<h2 data-start="1343" data-end="1420">The “responsible pruning” framework (aka the honest way to be influential)</h2>
<p data-start="1421" data-end="1483">Use a filter like this (your “lemon worth the squeeze” style):</p>
<h3 data-start="1485" data-end="1521">Filter 1 — Does the lemon exist?</h3>
<ul data-start="1522" data-end="1611">
<li data-start="1522" data-end="1567">
<p data-start="1524" data-end="1567">Is this measurable with the available data?</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1568" data-end="1611">
<p data-start="1570" data-end="1611">Do we have enough signal without leakage?</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="1613" data-end="1652">Filter 2 — Is it worth the squeeze?</h3>
<ul data-start="1653" data-end="1756">
<li data-start="1653" data-end="1707">
<p data-start="1655" data-end="1707">Expected impact size (business effect, not just AUC)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1708" data-end="1723">
<p data-start="1710" data-end="1723">Time-to-value</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1724" data-end="1756">
<p data-start="1726" data-end="1756">Ops burden / change management</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="1758" data-end="1803">Filter 3 — Can we squeeze it sustainably?</h3>
<ul data-start="1804" data-end="1879">
<li data-start="1804" data-end="1821">
<p data-start="1806" data-end="1821">Maintainability</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1822" data-end="1846">
<p data-start="1824" data-end="1846">Monitoring feasibility</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1847" data-end="1879">
<p data-start="1849" data-end="1879">Failure modes and blast radius</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1881" data-end="2011">If Option C fails Filter 3 
(“technically possible, but operationally reckless”), you can justify 
excluding it without hand-waving.</p>
<hr data-start="2013" data-end="2016">
<h2 data-start="2018" data-end="2084">The move that keeps you honest <em data-start="2052" data-end="2057">and</em> keeps your shortlist tight</h2>
<p data-start="2085" data-end="2176"><strong data-start="2085" data-end="2176">Shortlist 3 options in the main doc… but keep a tiny “Alternatives considered” section.</strong></p>
<p data-start="2178" data-end="2186">Example:</p>
<p data-start="2188" data-end="2233"><strong data-start="2188" data-end="2233">Alternatives considered (not recommended)</strong></p>
<ul data-start="2234" data-end="2409">
<li data-start="2234" data-end="2409">
<p data-start="2236" data-end="2409"><strong data-start="2236" data-end="2249">Option C:</strong> &lt;one sentence&gt;<br data-start="2264" data-end="2267">
<em data-start="2269" data-end="2295">Not recommended because:</em> (1–2 concrete reasons: high leakage risk / requires unavailable label / unmonitorable / creates incentive issues)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="2411" data-end="2432">This does two things:</p>
<ul data-start="2433" data-end="2548">
<li data-start="2433" data-end="2490">
<p data-start="2435" data-end="2490">protects you from “you never told us that was possible”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2491" data-end="2548">
<p data-start="2493" data-end="2548">makes your influence <em data-start="2514" data-end="2527">transparent</em> instead of invisible</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="2550" data-end="2670">It also maps perfectly to CRISP-DM’s emphasis on documentation/process instance: you’re recording what happened and why.</p>
<hr data-start="2672" data-end="2675">
<h2 data-start="2677" data-end="2726">Why analysts underestimate their own influence</h2>
<p data-start="2727" data-end="2793">Because you’re not choosing the business action — you’re choosing:</p>
<ul data-start="2794" data-end="2935">
<li data-start="2794" data-end="2827">
<p data-start="2796" data-end="2827">what gets defined as “possible”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2828" data-end="2857">
<p data-start="2830" data-end="2857">what gets defined as “safe”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2858" data-end="2890">
<p data-start="2860" data-end="2890">what gets defined as “success”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2891" data-end="2935">
<p data-start="2893" data-end="2935">what’s considered “too risky to recommend”</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="2937" data-end="2998">That’s not minor. That’s basically <strong data-start="2972" data-end="2997">decision architecture</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="3000" data-end="3064">And it’s <em data-start="3009" data-end="3021">especially</em> powerful because leadership often assumes:</p>
<blockquote data-start="3065" data-end="3123">
<p data-start="3067" data-end="3123">“If there was a better option, it would be on the list.”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="3125" data-end="3165">So the list <em data-start="3137" data-end="3141">is</em> the strategy, in a way.</p>
<hr data-start="3167" data-end="3170">
<h2 data-start="3172" data-end="3237">A practical sentence you can use (work + your Module 5 report)</h2>
<blockquote data-start="3238" data-end="3472">
<p data-start="3240" data-end="3472">“I explored several approaches and 
narrowed to the three that best fit our constraints (timeline, data 
availability, operational lift). I can walk through other approaches we 
considered, but they were deprioritized due to [reason].”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="3474" data-end="3582">That’s honest, it signals competence, and it documents your filtering logic without dumping 8 paths on them.</p>
<hr data-start="3584" data-end="3587">
<p data-start="3589" data-end="3750">If you want to make this bulletproof for the course, we can build a reusable <strong data-start="3666" data-end="3701">“Options &amp; Tradeoffs” one-pager</strong> you can drop into Module 5 / 9 / 13. It’ll have:</p>
<ul data-start="3751" data-end="3935">
<li data-start="3751" data-end="3791">
<p data-start="3753" data-end="3791">3 recommended options (with tradeoffs)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3792" data-end="3846">
<p data-start="3794" data-end="3846">2–5 “considered but not recommended” (one line each)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3847" data-end="3883">
<p data-start="3849" data-end="3883">explicit constraints + assumptions</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3884" data-end="3935">
<p data-start="3886" data-end="3935">your recommendation + “what would change my mind”</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="3937" data-end="4033" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">That’s basically CRISP-DM Business Understanding + Evaluation thinking rolled into one artifact.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="z-0 flex min-h-[46px] justify-start"><div class="touch:-me-2 touch:-ms-3.5 -ms-2.5 -me-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-y-4 p-1 select-none [.text-message+&amp;]:mt-1" data-message-model-slug="gpt-5-2-thinking"><div class="flex w-full flex-col gap-1 empty:hidden first:pt-[1px]"><div class="markdown prose dark:prose-invert w-full wrap-break-word dark markdown-new-styling"><p data-start="0" data-end="119">Yes — that’s <em data-start="13" data-end="22">exactly</em> the point. “Option C creates perverse incentives” isn’t just a vibe; it’s usually a signal that:</p>
<ol data-start="121" data-end="239">
<li data-start="121" data-end="175">
<p data-start="124" data-end="175"><strong data-start="124" data-end="149">The metric is a proxy</strong>, not the real goal, and</p>
</li>
<li data-start="176" data-end="239">
<p data-start="179" data-end="239">If you optimize the proxy, people will (rationally) game it.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="241" data-end="328">So the “better option 3” is often: <strong data-start="276" data-end="327">same intent, different measurement + guardrails</strong>.</p>
<h3 data-start="330" data-end="363">What’s really happening in #3</h3>
<p data-start="364" data-end="483">You’re not rejecting Option C because you “don’t like it.”<br data-start="422" data-end="425">
You’re rejecting it because it fails a hidden requirement:</p>
<blockquote data-start="485" data-end="563">
<p data-start="487" data-end="563">“This solution must not incentivize behavior that harms the true objective.”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="565" data-end="629">That’s a legit constraint. Most orgs just don’t say it out loud.</p>
<p data-start="631" data-end="755">This is basically <strong data-start="649" data-end="667">Goodhart’s Law</strong> in business clothing: <em data-start="690" data-end="755">when a measure becomes a target, it stops being a good measure.</em></p>
<hr data-start="757" data-end="760">
<h2 data-start="762" data-end="836">The move: turn “perverse incentives” into an explicit design constraint</h2>
<p data-start="837" data-end="881">Instead of “Option C is bad,” write it like:</p>
<ul data-start="883" data-end="1108">
<li data-start="883" data-end="942">
<p data-start="885" data-end="942"><strong data-start="885" data-end="894">Risk:</strong> optimizing X will drive unintended behavior Y</p>
</li>
<li data-start="943" data-end="994">
<p data-start="945" data-end="994"><strong data-start="945" data-end="959">Mechanism:</strong> X is a proxy for the true goal Z</p>
</li>
<li data-start="995" data-end="1063">
<p data-start="997" data-end="1063"><strong data-start="997" data-end="1012">Mitigation:</strong> add guardrail metrics / constraints / monitoring</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1064" data-end="1108">
<p data-start="1066" data-end="1108"><strong data-start="1066" data-end="1084">Residual risk:</strong> what can still go wrong</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1110" data-end="1174">Now you’ve converted preference into <em data-start="1147" data-end="1173">engineering + governance</em>.</p>
<hr data-start="1176" data-end="1179">
<h2 data-start="1181" data-end="1239">The “better option 3” patterns (these are your toolbox)</h2>
<h3 data-start="1240" data-end="1309">Pattern A — Replace a single metric with a <strong data-start="1287" data-end="1309">balanced scorecard</strong></h3>
<p data-start="1310" data-end="1348">Instead of “optimize X,” you optimize:</p>
<ul data-start="1350" data-end="1502">
<li data-start="1350" data-end="1405">
<p data-start="1352" data-end="1405"><strong data-start="1352" data-end="1370">Primary metric</strong> (the thing leadership cares about)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1406" data-end="1452">
<p data-start="1408" data-end="1452"><strong data-start="1408" data-end="1422">Guardrails</strong> (things that must not worsen)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1453" data-end="1502">
<p data-start="1455" data-end="1502"><strong data-start="1455" data-end="1475">Quality / safety</strong> checks (to prevent gaming)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1504" data-end="1737"><strong data-start="1504" data-end="1538">Example (healthcare-flavored):</strong><br data-start="1538" data-end="1541">
Primary: reduce ED LOS<br data-start="1563" data-end="1566">
Guardrails: bounceback rate, ICU upgrades within 24h, patient satisfaction, left-without-being-seen, admit rate<br data-start="1677" data-end="1680">
If LOS improves but bouncebacks spike, the “win” is fake.</p>
<p data-start="1739" data-end="1807">This is the cleanest way to keep Option C but defang the incentives.</p>
<h3 data-start="1809" data-end="1851">Pattern B — Constrain the optimization</h3>
<p data-start="1852" data-end="1888">You can literally define success as:</p>
<blockquote data-start="1890" data-end="1939">
<p data-start="1892" data-end="1939">“Improve X <strong data-start="1903" data-end="1917">subject to</strong> Y not getting worse.”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1941" data-end="2004">That turns perverse incentives into math / acceptance criteria.</p>
<h3 data-start="2006" data-end="2078">Pattern C — Measure closer to the real objective (reduce proxy-ness)</h3>
<p data-start="2079" data-end="2157">Perverse incentives thrive when you measure the wrong thing because it’s easy.</p>
<p data-start="2159" data-end="2182">So “Option 3” is often:</p>
<ul data-start="2183" data-end="2318">
<li data-start="2183" data-end="2264">
<p data-start="2185" data-end="2264">“Stop using the cheap proxy; use a closer-to-truth label, even if it’s harder.”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2265" data-end="2318">
<p data-start="2267" data-end="2318">Or “combine two imperfect measures to triangulate.”</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="2320" data-end="2380">Pattern D — Narrow the use case (limit the blast radius)</h3>
<p data-start="2381" data-end="2436">If a metric will be gamed at enterprise scale, you can:</p>
<ul data-start="2437" data-end="2557">
<li data-start="2437" data-end="2471">
<p data-start="2439" data-end="2471">deploy only for a subset (pilot)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2472" data-end="2519">
<p data-start="2474" data-end="2519">restrict to decision-support (no auto-action)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2520" data-end="2557">
<p data-start="2522" data-end="2557">require human review for edge cases</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="2559" data-end="2562">
<h2 data-start="2564" data-end="2611">How to present it without sounding political</h2>
<p data-start="2612" data-end="2706">When there are 8 options, your shortlist is fine. The honest + high-influence way to do it is:</p>
<h3 data-start="2708" data-end="2735">Recommended (shortlist)</h3>
<ul data-start="2736" data-end="2798">
<li data-start="2736" data-end="2748">
<p data-start="2738" data-end="2748">Option A …</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2749" data-end="2761">
<p data-start="2751" data-end="2761">Option B …</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2762" data-end="2798">
<p data-start="2764" data-end="2798">Option D (the “better option 3”) …</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="2800" data-end="2851">Considered but not recommended (1–2 lines each)</h3>
<ul data-start="2852" data-end="3062">
<li data-start="2852" data-end="3062">
<p data-start="2854" data-end="3062"><strong data-start="2854" data-end="2867">Option C:</strong> <em data-start="2868" data-end="3060">Not
 recommended because it optimizes proxy metric X in a way that 
predictably drives Y (unintended behavior). If leadership wants to 
pursue it anyway, we’d need guardrails G1–G3 and a pilot.</em></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="3064" data-end="3136">That last sentence is key: you’re not hiding it — you’re <strong data-start="3121" data-end="3135">pricing it</strong>.</p>
<hr data-start="3138" data-end="3141">
<h2 data-start="3143" data-end="3194">Quick test: “Is this a perverse incentive risk?”</h2>
<p data-start="3195" data-end="3310">If people can improve the metric by doing something that <em data-start="3252" data-end="3291">looks good on paper but hurts reality</em>, you’re in danger.</p>
<p data-start="3312" data-end="3316">Ask:</p>
<ol data-start="3317" data-end="3477">
<li data-start="3317" data-end="3373">
<p data-start="3320" data-end="3373">“If a manager wanted to game this, how would they?”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3374" data-end="3417">
<p data-start="3377" data-end="3417">“Would that gaming be hard to detect?”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3418" data-end="3477">
<p data-start="3421" data-end="3477">“Would we still declare success if the gaming happened?”</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="3479" data-end="3552">If the answer is “yes,” you either need guardrails or a different metric.</p>
<hr data-start="3554" data-end="3557">
<h2 data-start="3559" data-end="3614">Why this is peak analyst influence (and why it’s OK)</h2>
<p data-start="3615" data-end="3782">Because leadership usually <em data-start="3642" data-end="3650">cannot</em> see second-order effects until after rollout.<br data-start="3696" data-end="3699">
You’re the person making the consequences visible <strong data-start="3749" data-end="3759">before</strong> the org pays for them.</p>
<p data-start="3784" data-end="3860">That’s not overstepping — that’s literally what “options + tradeoffs” means.</p>
<hr data-start="3862" data-end="3865">
<p data-start="3867" data-end="3950">If you want, throw me a concrete example (doesn’t need PHI — just the shape of it):</p>
<ul data-start="3952" data-end="4052">
<li data-start="3952" data-end="3996">
<p data-start="3954" data-end="3996">What’s the metric people want to optimize?</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3997" data-end="4052">
<p data-start="3999" data-end="4052">What’s the behavior you’re worried it will encourage?</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="4054" data-end="4275" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">I’ll
 give you 2–3 “better option 3” designs (balanced scorecard / 
constraints / narrower deployment) written in CRISP-DM-style language 
you can drop into Module 5 as an <em data-start="4223" data-end="4265">Assess Situation → Risks &amp; Contingencies</em> artifact.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="z-0 flex min-h-[46px] wrap-break-word dark markdown-new-styling"><p data-start="0" data-end="143">Yeah… you just described the part nobody teaches in “data science”: <strong data-start="68" data-end="142">the words you put on the slide <em data-start="101" data-end="140">become the reality people argue about</em></strong>.</p>
<p data-start="145" data-end="215">“Delays start in the waiting room” is a grenade because it reads like:</p>
<ul data-start="216" data-end="414">
<li data-start="216" data-end="267">
<p data-start="218" data-end="267">blame (front desk / nursing / triage / staffing),</p>
</li>
<li data-start="268" data-end="414">
<p data-start="270" data-end="414">and location-based judgment (“the waiting room is the problem”),<br>
instead of a systems statement about <strong data-start="372" data-end="413">demand exceeding constrained capacity</strong>.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="416" data-end="492">What your data actually supports (based on what you described) is closer to:</p>
<blockquote data-start="494" data-end="629">
<p data-start="496" data-end="629"><strong data-start="496" data-end="629">The
 earliest measurable signal of throughput constraint is increased time 
from RN triage → provider medical screening exam (MSE).</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="631" data-end="689">That’s a <em data-start="640" data-end="655">system signal</em>, not a “waiting room” accusation.</p>
<hr data-start="691" data-end="694">
<h2 data-start="696" data-end="751">A politics-safe way to say it (while staying honest)</h2>
<h3 data-start="753" data-end="818">Option 1: The “canary / early warning” framing (what you did)</h3>
<ul data-start="819" data-end="1019">
<li data-start="819" data-end="904">
<p data-start="821" data-end="904"><strong data-start="821" data-end="904">“Time from triage to MSE is our early warning indicator for system constraint.”</strong></p>
</li>
<li data-start="905" data-end="1019">
<p data-start="907" data-end="1019"><strong data-start="907" data-end="1019">“EV behaves like a canary in the coal mine: when capacity tightens, it’s the first interval that stretches.”</strong></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="1021" data-end="1091">Option 2: The “pressure gauge” framing (less cute, more executive)</h3>
<ul data-start="1092" data-end="1271">
<li data-start="1092" data-end="1172">
<p data-start="1094" data-end="1172"><strong data-start="1094" data-end="1172">“Triage-to-MSE time is a sensitive indicator of demand-capacity mismatch.”</strong></p>
</li>
<li data-start="1173" data-end="1271">
<p data-start="1175" data-end="1271"><strong data-start="1175" data-end="1271">“When arrivals exceed available provider capacity, the pre-provider interval expands first.”</strong></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="1273" data-end="1341">Option 3: The “queue mechanics” framing (clinically/ops precise)</h3>
<ul data-start="1342" data-end="1538">
<li data-start="1342" data-end="1435">
<p data-start="1344" data-end="1435"><strong data-start="1344" data-end="1435">“The front-end clinical evaluation queue lengthens first under throughput constraints.”</strong></p>
</li>
<li data-start="1436" data-end="1538">
<p data-start="1438" data-end="1538"><strong data-start="1438" data-end="1538">“The delay is not ‘in the waiting room’; it’s in the <em data-start="1493" data-end="1511">time-to-provider</em> segment of the pathway.”</strong></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1540" data-end="1565">Notice what these all do:</p>
<ul data-start="1566" data-end="1801">
<li data-start="1566" data-end="1620">
<p data-start="1568" data-end="1620">They name <strong data-start="1578" data-end="1605">the measurable interval</strong> (triage → MSE)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1621" data-end="1694">
<p data-start="1623" data-end="1694">They attribute causality to <strong data-start="1651" data-end="1682">capacity constraints / flow</strong>, not people</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1695" data-end="1801">
<p data-start="1697" data-end="1801">They set up <strong data-start="1709" data-end="1730">actionable levers</strong> (provider coverage, fast-track, EV workflow), instead of defensiveness</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="1803" data-end="1806">
<h2 data-start="1808" data-end="1858">A clean slide title + subtitle you can hand him</h2>
<p data-start="1859" data-end="2041"><strong data-start="1859" data-end="1869">Title:</strong> <em data-start="1870" data-end="1927">EV time is the earliest signal of throughput constraint</em><br data-start="1927" data-end="1930">
<strong data-start="1930" data-end="1943">Subtitle:</strong> <em data-start="1944" data-end="2041">As system load increases, the triage → MSE interval expands first (demand &gt; provider capacity).</em></p>
<p data-start="2043" data-end="2069">Or if you want even safer:</p>
<p data-start="2071" data-end="2238"><strong data-start="2071" data-end="2081">Title:</strong> <em data-start="2082" data-end="2144">Time-to-provider is the first interval to stretch under load</em><br data-start="2144" data-end="2147">
<strong data-start="2147" data-end="2160">Subtitle:</strong> <em data-start="2161" data-end="2238">We monitor triage → MSE as an early indicator of front-end capacity strain.</em></p>
<hr data-start="2240" data-end="2243">
<h2 data-start="2245" data-end="2319">Why “waiting room” is politically radioactive (and analytically sloppy)</h2>
<p data-start="2320" data-end="2368">It collapses 3 different things into one phrase:</p>
<ol data-start="2370" data-end="2503">
<li data-start="2370" data-end="2404">
<p data-start="2373" data-end="2404"><strong data-start="2373" data-end="2385">Location</strong> (“waiting room”)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2405" data-end="2468">
<p data-start="2408" data-end="2468"><strong data-start="2408" data-end="2419">Process</strong> (queue between triage and provider evaluation)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2469" data-end="2503">
<p data-start="2472" data-end="2503"><strong data-start="2472" data-end="2485">Causality</strong> (“delays start…”)</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="2505" data-end="2688">Even if it’s <em data-start="2518" data-end="2531">technically</em>
 true that the patient is physically in the waiting room, it implies the
 waiting room is where the problem originates, rather than being the 
visible symptom.</p>
<p data-start="2690" data-end="2740">If you want a neutral replacement vocabulary, use:</p>
<ul data-start="2741" data-end="2860">
<li data-start="2741" data-end="2765">
<p data-start="2743" data-end="2765"><strong data-start="2743" data-end="2765">“time-to-provider”</strong></p>
</li>
<li data-start="2766" data-end="2795">
<p data-start="2768" data-end="2795"><strong data-start="2768" data-end="2795">“pre-provider interval”</strong></p>
</li>
<li data-start="2796" data-end="2826">
<p data-start="2798" data-end="2826"><strong data-start="2798" data-end="2826">“triage-to-MSE interval”</strong></p>
</li>
<li data-start="2827" data-end="2860">
<p data-start="2829" data-end="2860"><strong data-start="2829" data-end="2860">“front-end evaluation time”</strong></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="2862" data-end="2895">Those are harder to misinterpret.</p>
<hr data-start="2897" data-end="2900">
<h2 data-start="2902" data-end="2951">The “message map” that keeps you out of fights</h2>
<p data-start="2952" data-end="3022">If you structure the narrative this way, you’ll avoid 80% of pushback:</p>
<ol data-start="3024" data-end="3288">
<li data-start="3024" data-end="3068">
<p data-start="3027" data-end="3068"><strong data-start="3027" data-end="3048">What we measured:</strong> “triage → MSE time”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3069" data-end="3141">
<p data-start="3072" data-end="3141"><strong data-start="3072" data-end="3094">What it indicates:</strong> “sensitive to provider capacity / system load”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3142" data-end="3217">
<p data-start="3145" data-end="3217"><strong data-start="3145" data-end="3174">What it does <em data-start="3160" data-end="3165">not</em> imply:</strong> “not blaming triage or ‘the waiting room’”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3218" data-end="3288">
<p data-start="3221" data-end="3288"><strong data-start="3221" data-end="3249">What we can do about it:</strong> “operational levers + expected effect”</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="3290" data-end="3348">That 3rd line (“does not imply”) is the politics antidote.</p>
<hr data-start="3350" data-end="3353">
<h2 data-start="3355" data-end="3405">You just hit a core CRISP-DM lesson, by the way</h2>
<p data-start="3406" data-end="3476">This is <em data-start="3414" data-end="3457">Business Understanding / Assess Situation</em> in the real world:</p>
<ul data-start="3477" data-end="3605">
<li data-start="3477" data-end="3503">
<p data-start="3479" data-end="3503">stakeholders hear blame,</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3504" data-end="3547">

<li data-start="3548" data-end="3605">

</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="3607" data-end="3695">So your “stroke moment” wasn’t drama — it was you protecting the project from derailing.</p>

Course Assignment Structure

This course centers on three major assignments that follow the CRISP-DM data science methodology. Each assignment builds on the previous work, culminating in a complete data science project from problem identification to organizational recommendations.
Assignment 1: Business and Data Understanding Report

Due: Module 5

Length: 10-15 pages

Focus: Problem framing and data exploration

    Analyze provided business scenario to identify data science opportunities

    Conduct comprehensive exploratory data analysis

    Assess data quality and identify limitations

    Establish clear project objectives and success criteria

Deliverables:

    Professional report documenting business context and data landscape

    Code repository showing exploration process

Click on the file below to preview the assignment 1 description.
Assignment 2: Data Preparation and Modeling Report

Due: Module 9

Length: 10-14 pages

Focus: Technical implementation

    Clean and prepare dataset for modeling

    Engineer features and transform data as needed

    Build and evaluate multiple modeling approaches

    Select best-performing model with rigorous evaluation

Deliverables:

    Technical report documenting preparation and modeling process

    Code repository with data preparation pipeline and model development

    Final prepared datasets and model artifacts

Click on the file below to preview the assignment 2 description.
Assignment 3: Final Report

Due: Module 13

Length: 10-12 pages + 3-slide presentation

Focus: Organizational impact and project reflection

    Interpret model results for business stakeholders

    Assess deployment feasibility and organizational risks

    Develop implementation recommendations

    Reflect on project process and lessons learned

Deliverables:

    Executive report with organizational implications and recommendations

    3-slide executive presentation

    Complete project repository with all work integrated

<h2 data-start="2478" data-end="2559">3) A “Definition of Done” for each module (so you always know you’re on track)</h2>

<p data-start="2612" data-end="2635"><strong data-start="2612" data-end="2635">Done when you have:</strong></p>
<ul data-start="2636" data-end="2829">
<li data-start="2636" data-end="2681">
<p data-start="2638" data-end="2681">A 1-page “problem framing memo” (see below)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2682" data-end="2738">
<p data-start="2684" data-end="2738">A bullet list of candidate target variables / outcomes</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2739" data-end="2778">

</li>
<li data-start="2779" data-end="2829">

</li>

<p data-start="3057" data-end="3151">Assignment 1 report outline filled in with real findings <span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="relative inline-flex items-center"><button class="ms-1 flex h-[25px] text-[10px] leading-[13px] rounded-xl corner-superellipse/1.1 items-center justify-center gap-1 px-2 relative text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#554074" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">M5 Assignment 1 - Business and …</p></button></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>

</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="3781" data-end="3784">
<h2 data-start="3786" data-end="3870">4) The 1-page memo you should write <em data-start="3825" data-end="3830">now</em> (this makes every later section easier)</h2>
<p data-start="3872" data-end="3907">Call it: <strong data-start="3881" data-end="3907">Project Charter (v0.1)</strong></p>
<p data-start="3909" data-end="3917">Include:</p>
<ol data-start="3918" data-end="4335">
<li data-start="3918" data-end="3958">
<p data-start="3921" data-end="3958"><strong data-start="3921" data-end="3958">Problem statement (2–3 sentences)</strong></p>
</li>
<li data-start="3959" data-end="4029">
<p data-start="3962" data-end="4029"><strong data-start="3962" data-end="3985">Who cares + why now</strong> (stakeholders + decision they need to make)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4030" data-end="4095">
<p data-start="4033" data-end="4095"><strong data-start="4033" data-end="4075">What you will predict/estimate/segment</strong> (technical framing)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4096" data-end="4212">
<p data-start="4099" data-end="4121"><strong data-start="4099" data-end="4119">Success criteria</strong></p>
<ul data-start="4125" data-end="4212">
<li data-start="4125" data-end="4160">
<p data-start="4127" data-end="4160">technical metric(s) + threshold</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4164" data-end="4212">
<p data-start="4166" data-end="4212">organizational metric(s) (even if approximate)</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="4213" data-end="4286">
<p data-start="4216" data-end="4286"><strong data-start="4216" data-end="4251">Known constraints + assumptions</strong> (this is where politics sneaks in)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4287" data-end="4335">
<p data-start="4290" data-end="4335"><strong data-start="4290" data-end="4321">Risks / perverse incentives</strong> (1–2 bullets)</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="4337" data-end="4441">This charter becomes the spine of Assignment 1 sections 1.1–1.5. <span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="relative inline-flex items-center"><button class="ms-1 flex h-[25px] text-[10px] leading-[13px] rounded-xl corner-superellipse/1.1 items-center justify-center gap-1 px-2 relative text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#554074" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">M5 Assignment 1 - Business and …</p></button></span></span></p>
<hr data-start="4443" data-end="4446">
<h2 data-start="4448" data-end="4526">5) How we’ll work together module-by-module (your “collaboration contract”)</h2>
<p data-start="4528" data-end="4567">For each module, you drop one of these:</p>
<ul data-start="4568" data-end="4671">
<li data-start="4568" data-end="4604">
<p data-start="4570" data-end="4604"><strong data-start="4570" data-end="4600">Your rough notes / bullets</strong>, or</p>
</li>

<p data-start="4607" data-end="4630"><strong data-start="4607" data-end="4626">A draft section</strong>, or</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4631" data-end="4671">
<p data-start="4633" data-end="4671"><strong data-start="4633" data-end="4671">A plot/table + your interpretation</strong></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="4673" data-end="4712">And I’ll do three things, consistently:</p>
<ol data-start="4713" data-end="4941">
<li data-start="4713" data-end="4778">
<p data-start="4716" data-end="4778"><strong data-start="4716" data-end="4737">Tighten the logic</strong> (what follows from what, what’s assumed)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4779" data-end="4859">
<p data-start="4782" data-end="4859"><strong data-start="4782" data-end="4804">Harden the wording</strong> (exec-safe headlines, avoid unforced political errors)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4860" data-end="4941">
<p data-start="4863" data-end="4941"><strong data-start="4863" data-end="4883">Fill blind spots</strong> (missing sections, missing caveats, missing alternatives)</p>
</li>
</ol>
<hr data-start="4943" data-end="4946">
<h1 data-start="4948" data-end="5011">Module 1: Major Assignment Overview — what you should do next</h1>
<h3 data-start="5013" data-end="5072">Step A — Set up the repo skeleton + README (30 minutes)</h3>
<p data-start="5073" data-end="5172">Because you must submit the repo ZIP alongside each report. <span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="relative inline-flex items-center"><button class="ms-1 flex h-[25px] text-[10px] leading-[13px] rounded-xl corner-superellipse/1.1 items-center justify-center gap-1 px-2 relative text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#554074" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">Show Your Work-1</p></button></span></span></p>
<h3 data-start="5174" data-end="5236">Step B — Create the three report “shells” (empty outlines)</h3>
<ul data-start="5237" data-end="5332">
<li data-start="5237" data-end="5268">
<p data-start="5239" data-end="5268"><code data-start="5239" data-end="5268">docs/assignment1_outline.md</code></p>
</li>
<li data-start="5269" data-end="5300">
<p data-start="5271" data-end="5300"><code data-start="5271" data-end="5300">docs/assignment2_outline.md</code></p>
</li>
<li data-start="5301" data-end="5332">
<p data-start="5303" data-end="5332"><code data-start="5303" data-end="5332">docs/assignment3_outline.md</code></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="5334" data-end="5436">So when you learn something in Module 2, you paste it into the right future home instead of losing it.</p>
<h3 data-start="5438" data-end="5483">Step C — Start a decision log immediately</h3>
<p data-start="5484" data-end="5546">Every time you make a call like “exclude option C,” you write:</p>
<ul data-start="5547" data-end="5627">
<li data-start="5547" data-end="5557">
<p data-start="5549" data-end="5557">Decision</p>
</li>
<li data-start="5558" data-end="5578">
<p data-start="5560" data-end="5578">Options considered</p>
</li>
<li data-start="5579" data-end="5597">
<p data-start="5581" data-end="5597">Why you chose it</p>
</li>
<li data-start="5598" data-end="5627">
<p data-start="5600" data-end="5627">What would change your mind</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="5629" data-end="5707">That becomes free content later for “limitations,” “risks,” and “reflection.”</p>

<p data-start="225" data-end="446">Cool — let’s get you set up <em data-start="253" data-end="263">properly</em>
 on Pop!_OS with a GitHub-backed repo that’s “Show Your Work” ready 
(README + clean structure + reproducible Python env + the handful of <code data-start="400" data-end="405">.md</code> files that make the reports/diary easy).</p>
<p data-start="448" data-end="506">Below is a step-by-step you can literally follow in order.</p>
<hr data-start="508" data-end="511">
<h2 data-start="513" data-end="551">0) One-time machine setup (Pop!_OS)</h2>
<h3 data-start="552" data-end="570">Install basics</h3>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="571" data-end="655"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">sudo</span></span><span> apt update
</span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">sudo</span></span><span> apt install -y git python3 python3-venv python3-pip
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<h3 data-start="657" data-end="692">Configure git identity (global)</h3>
<p data-start="693" data-end="735">Use the email tied to your GitHub account:</p>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="736" data-end="931"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span>git config --global user.name </span><span><span class="hljs-string">"Luis Gonzalez"</span></span><span>
git config --global user.email </span><span><span class="hljs-string">"YOUR_EMAIL@example.com"</span></span><span>
git config --global init.defaultBranch main
git config --global pull.rebase </span><span><span class="hljs-literal">false</span></span><span>
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<hr data-start="933" data-end="936">
<h2 data-start="938" data-end="983">1) Authenticate to GitHub (SSH is easiest)</h2>
<h3 data-start="984" data-end="1017">Generate an SSH key (ed25519)</h3>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="1018" data-end="1128"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span>ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C </span><span><span class="hljs-string">"YOUR_EMAIL@example.com"</span></span><span>
</span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">eval</span></span><span> </span><span><span class="hljs-string">"<span class="hljs-subst">$(ssh-agent -s)</span></span></span><span>"
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<h3 data-start="1130" data-end="1153">Copy the public key</h3>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="1154" data-end="1191"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">cat</span></span><span> ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<p data-start="1193" data-end="1268">Now paste that into GitHub → <strong data-start="1222" data-end="1267">Settings → SSH and GPG keys → New SSH key</strong>.</p>
<h3 data-start="1270" data-end="1281">Test it</h3>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="1282" data-end="1315"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span>ssh -T git@github.com
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<p data-start="1316" data-end="1376">You want a success message (it’ll say you’ve authenticated).</p>
<hr data-start="1378" data-end="1381">
<h2 data-start="1383" data-end="1415">2) Create the repo + clone it</h2>
<h3 data-start="1416" data-end="1466">Option A (CLI) – recommended if you want speed</h3>
<p data-start="1467" data-end="1507">Install GitHub CLI if you don’t have it:</p>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="1508" data-end="1556"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">sudo</span></span><span> apt install -y gh
gh auth login
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<p data-start="1558" data-end="1578">Create repo + clone:</p>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="1579" data-end="1670"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span>gh repo create case-studies-capstone --private --</span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">clone</span></span><span>
</span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">cd</span></span><span> case-studies-capstone
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<h3 data-start="1672" data-end="1690">Option B (Web)</h3>
<p data-start="1691" data-end="1724">Create repo in the browser, then:</p>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="1725" data-end="1825"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span>git </span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">clone</span></span><span> git@github.com:YOURUSERNAME/case-studies-capstone.git
</span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">cd</span></span><span> case-studies-capstone
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<hr data-start="1827" data-end="1830">
<h2 data-start="1832" data-end="1894">3) Create the “capstone skeleton” (folders + core markdown)</h2>
<p data-start="1895" data-end="1925">Run this from inside the repo:</p>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="1927" data-end="2270"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">mkdir</span></span><span> -p data/{raw,interim,processed} notebooks src outputs/{figures,tables,models} docs reports references
</span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">touch</span></span><span> .gitignore README.md
</span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">touch</span></span><span> docs/00_master_tracker.md docs/01_process_diary.md docs/02_decision_log.md docs/03_assumptions_risks.md
</span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">touch</span></span><span> reports/M05_assignment1.md reports/M09_assignment2.md reports/M13_assignment3.md
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<h3 data-start="2272" data-end="2304">Why these <code data-start="2286" data-end="2291">.md</code> files matter</h3>
<p data-start="2305" data-end="2376">They let you build the big reports <em data-start="2340" data-end="2355">incrementally</em> instead of cramming:</p>
<ul data-start="2377" data-end="2724">
<li data-start="2377" data-end="2455">
<p data-start="2379" data-end="2455"><code data-start="2379" data-end="2401">00_master_tracker.md</code> → module checklist + deadlines + “definition of done”</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2456" data-end="2551">
<p data-start="2458" data-end="2551"><code data-start="2458" data-end="2479">01_process_diary.md</code> → your process instance (easy points; also helps your final reflection)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2552" data-end="2653">
<p data-start="2554" data-end="2653"><code data-start="2554" data-end="2574">02_decision_log.md</code> → every major choice + why + tradeoffs (also becomes “limitations/risks” text)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2654" data-end="2724">
<p data-start="2656" data-end="2724"><code data-start="2656" data-end="2681">03_assumptions_risks.md</code> → the CRISP-DM “Assess Situation” goldmine</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="2726" data-end="2729">
<h2 data-start="2731" data-end="2797">4) Add a sane <code data-start="2748" data-end="2760">.gitignore</code> (Python + notebooks + big artifacts)</h2>
<p data-start="2798" data-end="2825">Put this into <code data-start="2812" data-end="2824">.gitignore</code>:</p>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="2827" data-end="3220"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">gitignore</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-gitignore"><span># Python
__pycache__/
*.pyc
.venv/
.env

# Jupyter
.ipynb_checkpoints/

# OS/editor
.DS_Store
.vscode/
.idea/

# Outputs (usually large / reproducible)
outputs/models/
outputs/figures/
outputs/tables/

# Data (choose your strategy)
# If course rules allow including datasets, delete these ignores.
data/raw/
data/interim/
data/processed/

# But keep folder structure
!.gitkeep
</span></code></div></div></pre>
<p data-start="3222" data-end="3286">Then create <code data-start="3234" data-end="3244">.gitkeep</code> files so the empty folders still show up:</p>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="3287" data-end="3447"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">touch</span></span><span> data/raw/.gitkeep data/interim/.gitkeep data/processed/.gitkeep
</span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">touch</span></span><span> outputs/figures/.gitkeep outputs/tables/.gitkeep outputs/models/.gitkeep
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<p data-start="3449" data-end="3749"><strong data-start="3449" data-end="3463">Data note:</strong> some courses expect the dataset in your ZIP; others don’t. This setup defaults to <strong data-start="3546" data-end="3576">not committing data to Git</strong>,
 but you can still include data in the Coursera ZIP submission by 
temporarily copying it in. We can adjust once you see the “Show Your 
Work” wording for your specific case.</p>
<hr data-start="3751" data-end="3754">
<h2 data-start="3756" data-end="3810">5) Create a clean Python environment (reproducible)</h2>
<h3 data-start="3811" data-end="3851">Create venv + install common tooling</h3>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="3852" data-end="4030"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span>python3 -m venv .venv
</span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">source</span></span><span> .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
pip install jupyter pandas numpy scikit-learn matplotlib seaborn scipy statsmodels
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<p data-start="4032" data-end="4052">Freeze requirements:</p>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="4053" data-end="4094"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span>pip freeze &gt; requirements.txt
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<p data-start="4096" data-end="4175"><em data-start="4096" data-end="4175">(Later, after you add more packages, re-run <code data-start="4141" data-end="4172">pip freeze &gt; requirements.txt</code>.)</em></p>

<h2 data-start="4182" data-end="4230">6) Fill in README (this is what graders love)</h2>
<p data-start="4231" data-end="4279">Paste this into <code data-start="4247" data-end="4258">README.md</code> and tweak as you go:</p>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="4281" data-end="5291"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">markdown</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-markdown"><span><span><span class="hljs-section"># Case Studies in Data Science — Capstone</span></span><span>

</span><span><span class="hljs-section">## Project overview</span></span><span>
This repository contains my end-to-end case study work following the CRISP-DM framework:
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">-</span></span><span> Business Understanding / Data Understanding (Assignment 1, Module 5)
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">-</span></span><span> Data Preparation / Modeling (Assignment 2, Module 9)
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">-</span></span><span> Evaluation / Deployment (Assignment 3, Module 13)

</span><span><span class="hljs-section">## Repo structure</span></span><span>
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">-</span></span><span> </span><span><span class="hljs-code">`notebooks/`</span></span><span> — exploratory analysis, cleaning, modeling notebooks (run top-to-bottom)
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">-</span></span><span> </span><span><span class="hljs-code">`data/`</span></span><span> — raw/interim/processed datasets (may be excluded from git depending on course rules)
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">-</span></span><span> </span><span><span class="hljs-code">`outputs/`</span></span><span> — generated figures/tables/models
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">-</span></span><span> </span><span><span class="hljs-code">`reports/`</span></span><span> — report drafts aligned to M05/M09/M13
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">-</span></span><span> </span><span><span class="hljs-code">`docs/`</span></span><span> — tracker, process diary, decision log, assumptions/risks

</span><span><span class="hljs-section">## How to run</span></span><span>
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">1.</span></span><span> Create environment:
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span></span><span> </span><span><span class="hljs-code">`python3 -m venv .venv`</span></span><span>
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span></span><span> </span><span><span class="hljs-code">`source .venv/bin/activate`</span></span><span>
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span></span><span> </span><span><span class="hljs-code">`pip install -r requirements.txt`</span></span><span>
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">2.</span></span><span> Launch Jupyter:
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">   -</span></span><span> </span><span><span class="hljs-code">`jupyter lab`</span></span><span>

</span><span><span class="hljs-section">## Notes</span></span><span>
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">-</span></span><span> Notebooks are intended to run top-to-bottom.
</span><span><span class="hljs-bullet">-</span></span><span> Major decisions and assumptions are documented in </span><span><span class="hljs-code">`docs/`</span></span><span>.
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>

<h2 data-start="7261" data-end="7323">What I need from you to lock the last 10% (but no stalling)</h2>
<p data-start="7324" data-end="7548">Do you plan to use <strong data-start="7343" data-end="7354">Jupyter</strong> or <strong data-start="7358" data-end="7379">VS Code notebooks</strong> as your primary interface?<br data-start="7406" data-end="7409">

<p data-start="237" data-end="355">Yep — <strong data-start="243" data-end="315">it’s better not to install course libraries “directly on the system”</strong> (system Python). But the key nuance is:</p>
<ul data-start="357" data-end="580">
<li data-start="357" data-end="487">
<p data-start="359" data-end="487">If you use <code data-start="370" data-end="392">python -m venv .venv</code> and then <code data-start="402" data-end="419">pip install ...</code> <strong data-start="420" data-end="440">inside that venv</strong>, you’re <em data-start="449" data-end="454">not</em> installing on the system either.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="488" data-end="580">
<p data-start="490" data-end="580"><strong data-start="490" data-end="579"><code data-start="492" data-end="496">uv</code> just makes the “venv + install + lockfile” workflow faster and more reproducible</strong>.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="582" data-end="616"><code data-start="582" data-end="586">uv</code>’s project model is basically:</p>
<ul data-start="617" data-end="912">
<li data-start="617" data-end="671">
<p data-start="619" data-end="671"><code data-start="619" data-end="635">pyproject.toml</code> = what you <em data-start="647" data-end="653">want</em> (high-level deps)</p>
</li>
<li data-start="672" data-end="811">
<p data-start="674" data-end="811"><code data-start="674" data-end="683">uv.lock</code> = what you <em data-start="695" data-end="700">got</em> (exact resolved versions, reproducible) — and it <em data-start="750" data-end="771">should be committed</em> <span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="ms-1 inline-flex max-w-full items-center select-none relative top-[-0.094rem] animate-[show_150ms_ease-in]" data-testid="webpage-citation-pill" style="width: 63px;"><a href="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/projects/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" alt="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/projects/" class="flex h-4.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl px-2 text-[9px] font-medium transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out text-token-text-secondary! bg-[#F4F4F4]! dark:bg-[#303030]!" style="max-width: 63px;"><span class="relative start-0 bottom-0 flex h-full w-full items-center"><span class="flex h-4 w-full items-center justify-between overflow-hidden" style="opacity: 1; transform: none;"><span class="max-w-[15ch] grow truncate overflow-hidden text-center">Astral Docs</span></span></span></a></span></span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="812" data-end="912">
<p data-start="814" data-end="912"><code data-start="814" data-end="822">.venv/</code> = the isolated environment where deps are installed <span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="ms-1 inline-flex max-w-full items-center select-none relative top-[-0.094rem] animate-[show_150ms_ease-in]" data-testid="webpage-citation-pill" style="width: 63px;"><a href="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/projects/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" alt="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/projects/" class="flex h-4.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl px-2 text-[9px] font-medium transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out text-token-text-secondary! bg-[#F4F4F4]! dark:bg-[#303030]!" style="max-width: 63px;"><span class="relative start-0 bottom-0 flex h-full w-full items-center"><span class="flex h-4 w-full items-center justify-between overflow-hidden" style="opacity: 1; transform: none;"><span class="max-w-[15ch] grow truncate overflow-hidden text-center">Astral Docs</span></span></span></a></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 data-start="914" data-end="950">My recommendation for this course</h2>
<p data-start="951" data-end="1069">Use <strong data-start="955" data-end="999">uv + a project-local <code data-start="978" data-end="985">.venv</code> + <code data-start="988" data-end="997">uv.lock</code></strong>. It gives you speed, repeatability, and clean “show your work” repos.</p>
<hr data-start="1071" data-end="1074">
<h2 data-start="1076" data-end="1115">Pop!_OS setup (clean + reproducible)</h2>
<h3 data-start="1117" data-end="1136">1) Install <code data-start="1132" data-end="1136">uv</code></h3>
<p data-start="1137" data-end="1221">Astral’s recommended installer on macOS/Linux: <span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="ms-1 inline-flex max-w-full items-center select-none relative top-[-0.094rem] animate-[show_150ms_ease-in]" data-testid="webpage-citation-pill" style="width: 63px;"><a href="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener" alt="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com" class="flex h-4.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl px-2 text-[9px] font-medium transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out text-token-text-secondary! bg-[#F4F4F4]! dark:bg-[#303030]!" style="max-width: 63px;"><span class="relative start-0 bottom-0 flex h-full w-full items-center"><span class="flex h-4 w-full items-center justify-between overflow-hidden" style="opacity: 1; transform: none;"><span class="max-w-[15ch] grow truncate overflow-hidden text-center">Astral Docs</span></span></span></a></span></span></p>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="1222" data-end="1281"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span>curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<p data-start="1282" data-end="1391">(Alternative if you hate curl|sh: <code data-start="1316" data-end="1333">pipx install uv</code> is also supported. <span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="ms-1 inline-flex max-w-full items-center select-none relative top-[-0.094rem] animate-[show_150ms_ease-in]" data-testid="webpage-citation-pill" style="width: 63px;"><a href="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener" alt="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com" class="flex h-4.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl px-2 text-[9px] font-medium transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out text-token-text-secondary! bg-[#F4F4F4]! dark:bg-[#303030]!" style="max-width: 63px;"><span class="relative start-0 bottom-0 flex h-full w-full items-center"><span class="flex h-4 w-full items-center justify-between overflow-hidden" style="opacity: 1; transform: none;"><span class="max-w-[15ch] grow truncate overflow-hidden text-center">Astral Docs</span></span></span></a></span></span>)</p>
<p data-start="1393" data-end="1400">Verify:</p>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="1401" data-end="1425"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span>uv --version
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<hr data-start="1427" data-end="1430">
<h3 data-start="1432" data-end="1484">2) Initialize uv in an <em data-start="1459" data-end="1469">existing</em> repo (minimal)</h3>
<p data-start="1485" data-end="1640">Since you already have a repo and likely already have a README/etc, do <strong data-start="1556" data-end="1569">bare init</strong> (creates only <code data-start="1584" data-end="1600">pyproject.toml</code>). <span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="ms-1 inline-flex max-w-full items-center select-none relative top-[-0.094rem] animate-[show_150ms_ease-in]" data-testid="webpage-citation-pill" style="width: 63px;"><a href="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/projects/init/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" alt="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/projects/init/" class="flex h-4.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl px-2 text-[9px] font-medium transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out text-token-text-secondary! bg-[#F4F4F4]! dark:bg-[#303030]!" style="max-width: 63px;"><span class="relative start-0 bottom-0 flex h-full w-full items-center"><span class="flex h-4 w-full items-center justify-between overflow-hidden" style="opacity: 1; transform: none;"><span class="max-w-[15ch] grow truncate overflow-hidden text-center">Astral Docs</span></span></span></a></span></span></p>
<pre class="overflow-visible! px-0!" data-start="1641" data-end="1680"><div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl corner-superellipse/1.1 relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary"><div class="flex items-center text-token-text-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-sans justify-between h-9 bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary select-none rounded-t-2xl corner-t-superellipse/1.1">bash</div><div class="sticky top-[calc(var(--sticky-padding-top)+9*var(--spacing))]"><div class="absolute end-0 bottom-0 flex h-9 items-center pe-2"><div class="bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary text-token-text-secondary flex items-center gap-4 rounded-sm px-2 font-sans text-xs"><button class="flex gap-1 items-center select-none py-1" aria-label="Copy"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-o8lw6oto.svg#ce3544" fill="currentColor"></use></svg>Copy code</button></div></div></div><div class="overflow-y-auto p-4" dir="ltr"><code class="whitespace-pre! language-bash"><span><span><span class="hljs-built_in">cd</span></span><span> your-repo
uv init --bare
</span></span></code></div></div></pre>
<p data-start="1682" data-end="1773">This avoids uv creating starter files you don’t want. <span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="ms-1 inline-flex max-w-full items-center select-none relative top-[-0.094rem] animate-[show_150ms_ease-in]" data-testid="webpage-citation-pill" style="width: 63px;"><a href="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/projects/init/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" alt="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/projects/init/" class="flex h-4.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl px-2 text-[9px] font-medium transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out text-token-text-secondary! bg-[#F4F4F4]! dark:bg-[#303030]!" style="max-width: 63px;"><span class="relative start-0 bottom-0 flex h-full w-full items-center"><span class="flex h-4 w-full items-center justify-between overflow-hidden" style="opacity: 1; transform: none;"><span class="max-w-[15ch] grow truncate overflow-hidden text-center">Astral Docs</span></span></span></a></span></span></p>
<hr data-start="1775" data-end="1778">
<h3 data-start="1780" data-end="1816">3) Add the baseline course stack</h3>
<p data-start="1817" data-end="1939">This updates <code data-start="1830" data-end="1846">pyproject.toml</code>, creates/updates <code data-start="1864" data-end="1873">uv.lock</code>, and installs into <code data-start="1893" data-end="1900">.venv</code>. <span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="ms-1 inline-flex max-w-full items-center select-none relative top-[-0.094rem] animate-[show_150ms_ease-in]" data-testid="webpage-citation-pill" style="width: 63px;"><a href="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/projects/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" alt="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/projects/" class="flex h-4.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl px-2 text-[9px] font-medium transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out text-token-text-secondary! bg-[#F4F4F4]! dark:bg-[#303030]!" style="max-width: 63px;"><span class="relative start-0 bottom-0 flex h-full w-full items-center"><span class="flex h-4 w-full items-center justify-between overflow-hidden" style="opacity: 1; transform: none;"><span class="max-w-[15ch] grow truncate overflow-hidden text-center">Astral Docs</span></span></span></a></span></span></p>

<h3 data-start="2131" data-end="2170">4) Get/keep the environment in sync</h3>
<p data-start="2171" data-end="2191">Two common patterns:</p>
<p data-start="2193" data-end="2291"><strong data-start="2193" data-end="2253">A) “Just run stuff” (uv keeps you synced automatically):</strong> <span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="ms-1 inline-flex max-w-full items-center select-none relative top-[-0.094rem] animate-[show_150ms_ease-in]" data-testid="webpage-citation-pill" style="width: 63px;"><a href="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/projects/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" alt="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/projects/" class="flex h-4.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl px-2 text-[9px] font-medium transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out text-token-text-secondary! bg-[#F4F4F4]! dark:bg-[#303030]!" style="max-width: 63px;"><span class="relative start-0 bottom-0 flex h-full w-full items-center"><span class="flex h-4 w-full items-center justify-between overflow-hidden" style="opacity: 1; transform: none;"><span class="max-w-[15ch] grow truncate overflow-hidden text-center">Astral Docs</span></span></span></a></span></span></p>
